messages:
taylor: Starting 03:30 UTC deploy window. Scope: api, runtime, console, router. Staggered approach: api canary -> runtime pin+warm -> router header split -> console flag. Shout if ordering objection. @miguel @anika @arjun @lena :bell:
miguel: I'll own runtime. New image runtime:stable-2026-03 -> plan: pin to gate, warm gpu pool 6m, then scale down old pools after 15m. Will watch kv hit ratio and GC pauses.
anika: API ready. Canary at 0.5% first, health-checks 20s. If errors < 0.2% after 8m, move to 5%.
arjun: Console change is config-only (schema tweak). Will gate behind runtime green. Can flip in <90s if we need abort.
lena: Router header split validated in staging. I prefer shadow mirror at 10% for 6m to compare header routing behavior before split. If parity < 0.05% mismatches we're good.
sam: SRE ack. Rollback criteria I want in place: 1) error rate > 1% sustained 3m, 2) p99 increase > 500ms vs baseline, 3) cache miss rate > 5% uplift. If triggered: stop router ramp -> disable console flag -> revert api canary -> unpin runtime.
deploybot: Deploy created by taylor at 1776664444. Window 03:30-04:30 UTC. Orchestration: api-canary-0.5% -> runtime-pin -> warm -> router-shadow-10% -> ramp -> console-flip.
miguel: Pin command: `infractl pin --service runtime --ref runtime:stable-2026-03 --owner miguel --note "staggered 03:30"`
miguel: Warm command: `infractl warm --pool gpu-runtime --minutes 6`
anika: API patch snippet:
```
- weight: 0.5
  service: api
  variant: api-vnext
```

anika: Keeping canary at 0.5% for 8m, will post status after.
lena: Shadow started (10%) at 1776664520. Capturing header X-Client-Route and response parity.
sam: Dash link: `dash.prod/redwood/deploys/1776664444` - alerts wired to the rollback criteria. I'll call it if anything crosses thresholds.
miguel: Warm complete. No OOMs, kv hit ratio stable at 94%. Proceeding to pin now.
deploybot: runtime pinned to runtime:stable-2026-03 by miguel at 1776664570.
anika: API canary at 0.5% active. First 4m: 0 errors, p95 +30ms.
lena: Shadow parity 0.01% mismatch over 6m. No header drops. Planning router split to 25% next.
sam: Monitoring: error rate steady, p99 within +120ms. No cache issues.
arjun: Enabling console flag in 60s for a 2m smoke, will revert if anything flaps.
anika: Bumping api canary to 5% at 1776664625. Healthchecks still green.
lena: Router ramping header split to 25% at 1776664635. Watching for token CPU on router nodes.
sam: Token CPU saw a blip to 78% for 2m, under threshold. All other metrics normal.
miguel: After router ramp I'll start decommissioning old runtime pools gradually.
deploybot: Router header split at 25% confirmed at 1776664640.
arjun: Console flag finished smoke, enabling to 100% at 1776664655. No UI errors reported.
anika: API at 100% now, canary removed.
taylor: Nice work. Post-deploy ops: update release notes with runtime pinned rev and router header change, add ticket referencing dash prod link. Closing window unless any alerts surface before 04:30 UTC. :shipit:
